objectives.text: Find the card with one orange circle that a short grey house that is beside a tree is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two red plusses that a short red house that is next to another short red house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one black diamond that a tall blue house that is 2 tiles from a short red house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one blue heart that a lamppost that is 4 tiles from a short red house is next to.
Find the card with two black squares that a lamppost that is 4 tiles from a short red house is 3 tiles from.
Find the card with two green hearts that a tall blue house that is beside another tall blue house is beside.
Find the card with two black circles that a lamppost that is next to a tree is 3 tiles from.
Find the card with one black circle that a rock that is 4 tiles from a short blue house is beside.
Find the card with three yellow plusses that a short blue house that is 3 tiles from a short red house is next to.
Find the card with one green heart that a short red house that is 2 tiles from a short grey house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with three red stars that a short red house that is 3 tiles from a rock is next to.
Find the card with two blue hearts that a short red house that is 2 tiles from a tall blue house is beside.
Find the card with one blue square that a short grey house that is next to a lamppost is beside.
Find the card with three orange hearts that a short yellow house that is 2 tiles from a tall blue house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one red triangle that a rock that is next to a tree is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two yellow plusses that a rock that is 4 tiles from a short blue house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two blue circles that a lamppost that is next to a short grey house is 3 tiles from.
Find the card with two red hearts that a rock that is 4 tiles from a short blue house is 3 tiles from.
